records.rationale: Both proposals identify the exact Oracle Field Service product; official Oracle page explicitly says it combines automation and embedded AI, documents AI-driven workload forecasting, and states AI is embedded across field-service capabilities at no additional charge. This satisfies positive evidence and provides no-additional-cost inclusion, so adopt AI and AI-enabled. Retain weak binary applicability because the source record lacks a date/version and current features may not map historically; this is best-supported, not a forced label. Proposals differ on support strength.
